# What can you do with the free API? A comparison of Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) MCP and PDF addition limits

Every time the number of research PDFs or web articles increases, manually opening a browser and adding them to a notebook one by one is a waste of time.

However, if you start writing automation scripts without checking the official specifications, you will encounter rework due to unsupported operations or authentication errors.

Based on primary information (as of 2026-11-21) from the [**Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) official API**](https://developers.google.com/notebook/docs) and [**remote MCP server**](https://developers.google.com/notebook/docs/mcp) published on Google for Developers, I have organized the boundaries of what can be used right now and the current limitations.

By reading this article, you will take away **a decision-making table of 'what you can do now vs. what you cannot do yet'** and the procedures for connecting to a remote MCP from Claude Code and Cursor.

## 1. Comparison table of the boundaries between 'what you can do now' and 'what you cannot do yet'

[![Image](https://assets.st-note.com/img/1795247475-Uj8fgQ6Go2wHz5OkeDMYd3bV.jpg?width=1200)](https://assets.st-note.com/img/1795247475-Uj8fgQ6Go2wHz5OkeDMYd3bV.jpg?width=1200)

The current **Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) API** is in the **Early Access Public Preview** stage.

The scope of support based on the three pages of official documentation ([Overview](https://developers.google.com/notebook/docs) / [MCP Server](https://developers.google.com/notebook/docs/mcp) / [Roadmap](https://developers.google.com/notebook/docs/roadmap), as of 2026-11-21) is as follows.

**■ Usage fees and provision limits**

- **What you can do now (Public Preview current specifications)**: **Free public preview** (0 yen API usage fee, 100 RPM limit per project)
- **What you cannot do yet (limitations/official roadmap plans)**: Preview specifications before GA (SLA guarantee is not covered)

**■ Target accounts**

- **What you can do now (Public Preview current specifications)**: **Personal Google accounts only** (prior web sign-in required)
- **What you cannot do yet (limitations/official roadmap plans)**: **Google Workspace accounts not supported** (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`)

**■ MCP/API connection**

- **What you can do now (Public Preview current specifications)**: REST API (`/v1`) and **remote MCP** (`[https://notebook.googleapis.com/mcp`)](https://notebook.googleapis.com/mcp%60%EF%BC%89)
- **What you cannot do yet (limitations/official Roadmap plans)**: **API key not supported** / **OAuth tokens expire in about 1 hour**

**■ Web/Video/Text addition**

- **What you can do now (Public Preview current specifications)**: Add public Web/YouTube/Markdown via `CreateSource` (20 RPM) (up to 500,000 words/1 MB)
- **What you cannot do yet (limitations/official Roadmap plans)**: **Direct addition of Google Drive URLs is not supported** (listed on Roadmap)

**■ PDF/Image addition**

- **What you can do now (Public Preview current specifications)**: Add **PDF/images/audio/documents (up to 200 MiB)** via REST `UploadSource` (20 times/minute)
- **What you cannot do yet (limitations/official Roadmap plans)**: Single upload of files exceeding 200 MiB or 500,000 words is not possible

- **What you can do now (Public Preview current specifications)**: Create, list, retrieve, and update notebook titles, and check source status (e.g., `ACTIVE`)
- **What you cannot do yet (limitations/official roadmap plans)**: **Question answering (search), audio commentary/slide generation, and deletion of notes or sources are all currently unavailable**

The most important point is that, at this stage, it is not an "API for question answering or audio generation," but rather **an "API for automatically adding materials (Web, YouTube, Markdown, PDF, images)"**.

## 2. Notebook and source limits by tier from Free to Google AI Pro

The API itself is free during the preview period, but the creation limits vary depending on the subscription tier of your personal Google account (Source: [Rate limits and quotas](https://developers.google.com/notebook/docs/rate-limits), checked on: 2026-11-21).

**■ Free**

- **Notebook limit**: 100
- **Source limit per notebook**: 50
- **Source addition rate limit**: `CreateSource` 20 RPM / `UploadSource` 20 times/min

**■ Plus**

- **Notebook limit**: 200
- **Source limit per notebook**: 100
- **Source addition rate limit**: `CreateSource` 20 RPM / `UploadSource` 20 times/min

**■ Pro (Google AI Pro)**

- **Notebook limit**: 500
- **Source limit per notebook**: 300
- **Source addition rate limit**: `CreateSource` 20 RPM / `UploadSource` 20 times/min

**■ Ultra (Google AI Ultra)**

- **Notebook limit**: 500
- **Source limit per notebook**: 600
- **Source addition rate limit**: `CreateSource` 20 RPM / `UploadSource` 20 times/min

When uploading a large number of PDFs or web pages at once, you can prevent `429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` errors by adding a 3-4 second wait to ensure you do not exceed 20 items per minute.

## 3. Remote MCP (`[notebook.googleapis.com/mcp`) and the shortest procedure for adding PDFs](http://notebook.googleapis.com/mcp%60%EF%BC%89%E3%81%A8PDF%E8%BF%BD%E5%8A%A0%E3%81%AE%E6%9C%80%E7%9F%AD%E6%89%8B%E9%A0%86) Since the Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM) remote MCP server is hosted by Google, there is no need to start a server locally.

However, since the standard `gcloud auth print-access-token` lacks the `notebook` scope, you must specify the scope when obtaining a token for Application Default Credentials (ADC).

```
# 1. API有効化と notebook スコープ付き ADC ログイン
export PROJECT_ID="your-gcp-project-id"
gcloud services enable notebook.googleapis.com --project="$PROJECT_ID"
gcloud auth application-default login \
  --scopes="https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/notebook"

# 2. OAuth 2.0 トークン取得（有効期限は約1時間）
export ACCESS_TOKEN=$(gcloud auth application-default print-access-token)

# 3. Claude Code へリモートMCPサーバーを登録
claude mcp add gemini-notebook-api \
  --transport http https://notebook.googleapis.com/mcp \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  --header "x-goog-user-project: $PROJECT_ID"
```

To add local PDFs or images (up to 200 MiB), POST the file to the REST `UploadSource` endpoint (`[https://notebook.googleapis.com/upload/v1/notebooks/{NOTEBOOK_ID}/sources:uploadFile`](https://notebook.googleapis.com/upload/v1/notebooks/%7BNOTEBOOK_ID%7D/sources:uploadFile%60%EF%BC%89%E3%81%B8%E3%83%95%E3%82%A1%E3%82%A4%E3%83%AB%E3%82%92)`).

## 4. Practical benefits of implementation and failure avoidance checklist

### Practical benefits of implementation and points for standardization

- **Zero manual effort for document consolidation**: Consolidate research URLs, YouTube, Markdown, and PDFs into a notebook with a single command, preventing rework and registration omissions.
- **Time-saving effects of hybrid operation**: You can increase practical efficiency by automating document input via API/MCP while using the Web UI for cross-document questioning and audio commentary generation.

When trying this out today, please check the following four points in advance.

- **Use a personal Google account**: Google Workspace accounts will result in `403 WORKSPACE_ACCOUNT_NOT_SUPPORTED`, so verify with a personal account and do not include confidential company data.
- **Sign in to the Web UI once in advance**: Accounts that have never logged in to `[https://notebook.google.com`](https://notebook.google.com%60) in a browser will result in `404 NOT_FOUND`.
- **Prepare for hourly token expiration**: OAuth tokens expire in about an hour, so if you get `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, re-obtain it using `print-access-token`.
- **Reuse one notebook ID during testing**: Since deletion via API (`DeleteNotebook` / `DeleteSource`) is still on the roadmap and not yet supported, avoid creating a large number of unnecessary notebooks.
